-----1.) Year-To-Date Average Daily Balance
SELECT A.CURRENT_EOD_DATE, SUM(A.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL) AS 'YTD ADB', C.ORGKEY
    FROM BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES A
        LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP B ON B.ACID = A.ACID AND B.BANK_ID = A.BANK_ID
        LEFT JOIN BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS C ON C.CORE_CUST_ID = B.CUST_ID AND C.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
        LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER D ON D.ACID = A.ACID AND D.BANK_ID = A.BANK_ID
    WHERE 
        A.isActive = 1
        AND A.CURRENT_EOD_DATE = '' ---set date
        AND B.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE IN ('M', 'J')
        AND B.isLatest = 1 
        AND B.isActive = 1
        AND C.ORGKEY = '' ---set FCBS CIF
        AND D.SCHM_CODE NOT LIKE '09%' ---exclude dummy accounts
    GROUP BY A.CURRENT_EOD_DATE, C.ORGKEY

---Get number of account holders that are main/joint per account
WITH BalanceShareCount AS (
    SELECT 
    ACID, ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE
    ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ACID ORDER BY ACCT_POA_AS_SRL_NUM) AS ROWNUM
    FROM busc.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP 
    WHERE ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE IN ('M', 'J')
)
---List the account details of all accounts held by the Customer. Details include: bank, branch, currency, product ID, holder type, account status, 
,Tally AS (
    SELECT 
    C.ORGKEY ,A.ACID, D.FORACID, A.BANK_ID, D.SOL_ID, D.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE, D.SCHM_CODE, B.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE, G.ShareCount
    ,CASE WHEN D.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' and D.ACCT_CLS_DATE <= '2022-01-27' and D.SCHM_TYPE in ('CAA','SBA','TDA') THEN 'Closed' 
        WHEN D.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'N' and D.SCHM_TYPE in ('SBA','CAA') THEN E.ACCT_STATUS 
        WHEN D.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' and D.ACCT_CLS_DATE > '2022-01-27' and D.SCHM_TYPE in ('CAA','SBA') THEN E.ACCT_STATUS 
        WHEN D.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' and D.ACCT_CLS_DATE > '2022-01-27' and D.SCHM_TYPE in ('TDA') THEN F.ACCT_STATUS  
        WHEN D.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'N' and D.SCHM_TYPE in ('TDA') THEN F.ACCT_STATUS
        END as AccountStatus
    ,A.CURRENT_EOD_DATE, A.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL, DATEPART(dayofyear, A.CURRENT_EOD_DATE) AS DayOfYear
    ,(A.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL)/(DATEPART(dayofyear, A.CURRENT_EOD_DATE)) AS YTDADB
        FROM BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES A
            LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP B ON B.ACID = A.ACID AND B.BANK_ID = A.BANK_ID
            LEFT JOIN BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS C ON C.CORE_CUST_ID = B.CUST_ID AND C.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
            LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER D ON D.ACID = A.ACID AND D.BANK_ID = A.BANK_ID
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM BUSC.DEP_CASAMASTER WHERE isLatest = 1 AND isActive = 1) E ON E.ACID = A.ACID AND E.BANK_ID = A.BANK_ID
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM BUSC.DEP_TDMASTER WHERE isLatest = 1 AND isActive = 1) F ON F.ACID = A.ACID AND F.BANK_ID = A.BANK_ID
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT ACID, MAX(ROWNUM) AS ShareCount FROM BalanceShareCount GROUP BY ACID) G ON G.ACID = A.ACID
        WHERE 
            A.isActive = 1
            AND B.isLatest = 1 AND B.isActive = 1
            AND C.isLatest = 1 AND C.isActive = 1
            AND D.isLatest = 1 AND D.isActive = 1
)

    ,CASE WHEN D.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' and D.ACCT_CLS_DATE <= '2023-01-27' and D.SCHM_TYPE in ('CAA','SBA','TDA') THEN 'Closed'

DECLARE @date date

SET @date = '2023-01-27'
BEGIN
WITH exclude_FORACID AS (
SELECT FORACID FROM 
    (SELECT FORACID, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM busc.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER 
    WHERE isLatest = 1 and isActive = 1 and DEL_FLG != 'Y' GROUP BY FORACID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) A
)
,Tally AS (
    SELECT 
    A.ORGKEY, C.ACID, D.FORACID, A.BANK_ID, D.SOL_ID, D.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE, D.SCHM_CODE, D.SCHM_TYPE
    ,CASE WHEN D.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' and D.ACCT_CLS_DATE <= getdate() and D.SCHM_TYPE in ('CAA','SBA','TDA') THEN 'Closed' 
        WHEN D.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'N' and D.SCHM_TYPE in ('SBA','CAA') THEN E.ACCT_STATUS 
        WHEN D.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' and D.ACCT_CLS_DATE > getdate() and D.SCHM_TYPE in ('CAA','SBA') THEN E.ACCT_STATUS 
        WHEN D.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' and D.ACCT_CLS_DATE > getdate() and D.SCHM_TYPE in ('TDA') THEN F.ACCT_STATUS  
        WHEN D.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'N' and D.SCHM_TYPE in ('TDA') THEN F.ACCT_STATUS
        END as AccountStatus
    ,C.CURRENT_EOD_DATE, C.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL, DATEPART(dayofyear, C.CURRENT_EOD_DATE) AS DayOfYear
    ,(C.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL)/(DATEPART(dayofyear, C.CURRENT_EOD_DATE)) AS YTDADB
        FROM (SELECT * FROM BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS WHERE isLatest = 1 AND isActive = 1) A
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM BUSC.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP WHERE isLatest = 1 AND isActive = 1) B ON B.CUST_ID = A.CORE_CUST_ID AND B.BANK_ID = A.BANK_ID
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES WHERE isActive = 1) C ON C.ACID = B.ACID AND C.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER WHERE isLatest = 1 AND isActive = 1) D ON D.ACID = B.ACID AND D.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM BUSC.DEP_CASAMASTER WHERE isLatest = 1 AND isActive = 1) E ON E.ACID = B.ACID AND E.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM BUSC.DEP_TDMASTER WHERE isLatest = 1 AND isActive = 1) F ON F.ACID = B.ACID AND F.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
)
,Tally_Distinct AS(
    SELECT * FROM (SELECT FORACID, BANK_ID, SOL_ID, ACCT_CRNCY_CODE, SCHM_CODE, SCHM_TYPE, AccountStatus, CURRENT_EOD_DATE, ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL, DayOfYear, YTDADB
        FROM Tally GROUP BY FORACID, BANK_ID, SOL_ID, ACCT_CRNCY_CODE, SCHM_CODE, SCHM_TYPE, AccountStatus, CURRENT_EOD_DATE, ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL, DayOfYear, YTDADB) A
    WHERE FORACID NOT IN (SELECT * FROM exclude_FORACID)--- AND ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = 'USD'
    ---ORDER BY YTDADB DESC
)
SELECT SUM(ISNULL(VAR_CRNCY_UNITS, 1.00) * A.YTDADB) AS 'Total YTD ADB'
    FROM Tally_Distinct A
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM busc.GLD_RATELIST_HIST_TABLE WHERE isLatest = 1 AND VAR_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' AND RATECODE = 'REV' AND RTLIST_DATE = @date) B ON B.FXD_CRNCY_CODE = A.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE AND B.BANK_ID = A.BANK_ID
    WHERE A.SCHM_CODE NOT LIKE '09%'--- AND (A.AccountStatus <> 'Closed' OR A.AccountStatus IS NULL)
    AND A.CURRENT_EOD_DATE = @date
END
SELECT ISNULL(B.VAR_CRNCY_UNITS, 1.00), A.*---ISNULL(B.VAR_CRNCY_UNITS, 1.00), COUNT(*)
    FROM Tally_Distinct A
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM busc.GLD_RATELIST_HIST_TABLE WHERE isLatest = 1 AND VAR_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' AND RATECODE = 'REV' AND RTLIST_DATE = @date) B ON B.FXD_CRNCY_CODE = A.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE AND B.BANK_ID = A.BANK_ID
    WHERE A.SCHM_CODE NOT LIKE '09%' AND (A.AccountStatus <> 'Closed' OR A.AccountStatus IS NULL)
    AND A.CURRENT_EOD_DATE = @date
    GROUP BY ISNULL(B.VAR_CRNCY_UNITS, 1.00)
